metadata.description: NetConnect's Claude Code plugins — opinionated tooling for building, deploying, and operating NCI services.

plugins.name: golden-path
plugins.description: Walk a project through the NetConnect Golden Path's 10 checkpoints. Orchestrator skill + per-checkpoint skills + /golden-path:start slash command. Use to bootstrap a new NCI repo or add a single capability (Bunnyshell deploy, MCP, Keycloak SSO, etc.) to an existing one.

plugins.name: ssh-fleet
plugins.description: Everything to work with ssh-fleet from your AI, in one install: the ssh-fleet MCP connection (Keycloak SSO with your NCI account; your rights are your ssh-fleet account's) and the network-operations skill (investigation-first methodology, competing hypotheses, and a change lifecycle that never turns an anomaly into a production change). Works in Claude Code and ChatGPT/Codex.

plugins.name: ssh-fleet-connect
plugins.description: Just the ssh-fleet connection, for non-engineers: install, click Connect, sign in with your NetConnect account. No GitHub account needed; your rights are your ssh-fleet role's (readonly for the routing and commercial team). Works in Claude Desktop and Claude Code. Engineers who want the Claude Code hooks use the `ssh-fleet` plugin instead.
